faqs.question: How can I place an order?
variants: steps to purchase an item from the website
faqs.answer: Browse the products, add the items you like to your cart and click 'Checkout'. Enter your delivery address, choose a payment method and confirm the order.

faqs.question: How do I track my order?
faqs.answer: Go to 'My Orders' in your account and click 'Track Order'. You will also receive a tracking link by email and SMS once your parcel is shipped.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
variants: can I pay with a credit card or debit card
do you accept jazzcash or easypaisa
faqs.answer: We accept Visa and Mastercard credit/debit cards, JazzCash, Easypaisa, bank transfer and Cash on Delivery (COD).

faqs.question: Is Cash on Delivery available?
variants: can I pay cash when the order arrives
faqs.answer: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available in all major cities for orders up to Rs. 50,000.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Delivery takes 2-4 working days in major cities and 4-7 working days in other areas.

faqs.question: How much are the shipping charges?
faqs.answer: Shipping is free for orders above Rs. 3,000. For smaller orders a flat fee of Rs. 200 is charged.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order?
variants: I want to cancel my order
I changed my mind and don't want the order
faqs.answer: Yes. You can cancel an order from 'My Orders' before it is shipped. Once the parcel is dispatched it can no longer be cancelled, but you can return it after delivery.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
variants: how do I return a product
can I send an item back
how many days to return an item
faqs.answer: You can return most items within 14 days of delivery if they are unused and in their original packaging. Go to 'My Orders' and click 'Return Item'.

faqs.question: How do I get a refund?
variants: when will I get my money back
how long does a refund take
faqs.answer: Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5-7 working days after we receive the returned item. COD orders are refunded to your bank account or mobile wallet.

faqs.question: What should I do if I received a damaged or wrong product?
variants: product is faulty or not working
received a different product than I ordered
faqs.answer: We are sorry about that! Contact support within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the product and your order number. We will replace it or refund you at no extra cost.

faqs.question: How can I create an account?
variants: I want to make a new profile
can I sign up with google
faqs.answer: Click 'Sign Up' at the top of the page, enter your name, email and password, then verify your email address. You can also sign up with your Google account.

faqs.question: I forgot my password. How can I reset it?
variants: can't log in to my account
faqs.answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your registered email and we will send you a link to set a new password.

faqs.question: How can I change my delivery address?
variants: send the order to a different address
faqs.answer: Open 'My Account' > 'Addresses' to edit your address. To change the address of an order that is already placed, contact support before it is shipped.

faqs.question: Do you deliver internationally?
variants: can I order from another country
faqs.answer: At the moment we deliver only within Pakistan. International shipping will be available soon.

faqs.question: How can I contact customer support?
variants: how to talk to a human agent
I need help from your team
faqs.answer: You can email support@shopeasy.example, call 0300-0000000 (Mon-Sat, 9am-6pm) or use the live chat on our website.

faqs.question: What are your customer support working hours?
variants: which days is customer service open
faqs.answer: Our support team is available Monday to Saturday from 9:00 am to 6:00 pm.

faqs.question: Do you offer warranty on electronics?
variants: is there a guarantee on gadgets
warranty period for phones and laptops
faqs.answer: Yes. All electronics come with a manufacturer warranty of 6 to 12 months, mentioned on the product page. Keep your invoice for warranty claims.

faqs.question: Are the products original and authentic?
variants: are your products fake or copies
do you sell branded original goods
faqs.answer: Yes, we only sell 100% original products sourced directly from brands and authorized distributors.

faqs.question: How do I use a discount coupon or promo code?
variants: where do I enter a voucher code
my promo code is not working
faqs.answer: Enter the code in the 'Promo Code' box on the checkout page and click 'Apply'. The discount will be shown in your order total.

faqs.question: Do you have any sales or discounts running?
variants: is there a sale going on
faqs.answer: Yes! Check the 'Deals' page for current offers. Subscribe to our newsletter to get early access to seasonal sales.

faqs.question: Can I exchange a product for a different size or colour?
variants: swap an item for another size
change the colour of my product
faqs.answer: Yes, exchanges are accepted within 14 days for clothing and shoes, subject to stock availability. Select 'Exchange' instead of 'Return' in 'My Orders'.

faqs.question: Is my payment information safe?
variants: is it safe to pay online on your website
do you store my credit card details
faqs.answer: Absolutely. All payments are processed through encrypted, PCI-compliant gateways. We never store your card details.

faqs.question: What should I do if my order is delayed?
variants: my parcel has not arrived yet
faqs.answer: Please check your tracking link first. If your order is delayed by more than 3 days, contact support with your order number and we will investigate immediately.

faqs.question: Can I change or modify my order after placing it?
variants: add another item to my order
I want to modify an order I already placed
faqs.answer: You can modify items or quantities only before the order is shipped. Please contact support as soon as possible with your order number.

faqs.question: How do I subscribe or unsubscribe from the newsletter?
faqs.answer: Enter your email in the newsletter box at the bottom of the page to subscribe. To unsubscribe, click the 'Unsubscribe' link at the bottom of any newsletter email.
